newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Pastelerias Francesas in 95 mln peso IPO.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Pastelerias Francesas in 95 mln peso IPO.

text.p: Mexican bakers Pasteleria Francesas will launch an initial public offering in Mexico's Intermediate Market of between 84 million and 95 million pesos, the company said on Wednesday.
It told an analysts' meeting that 30 percent of the proceeds would be used to pay off debt and the other 70 percent would be earmarked as investment capital.
The issue price will be between 1.85 and 2.10 pesos per share with some 45.484 million shares slated to be sold.
Some 55 percent of the shares will be sold in a primary offering, and the rest in a secondary issue.
The offering will represent 17.47 percent of the company's capital. The company did not say when the IPO would be launched, but it said payment date for shares was May 19.
GMB Atlantico is the lead manager.
